# A clause that signposts its pair

`Policy: pol-ONEW` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

This side of the pair is sound. It signposts the clause sharing its id, and `pol-BACK` does not answer.

## Scope

This fixture only. It sets up `pair-one-way`, which reports the other side.

## Clauses

| Id       | Clause                                                                                  | Alignment |
|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `PAIRED` | **MUST** keep a record of each change ([pol-BACK].PAIRED states the same for a release) |           |

[pol-BACK]: back-pair-not-returned.md
